ayahOccurrences.text: قَالَ لَا تَثْرِيبَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ يَغْفِرُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: قَالَ لَا تَثْرِيبَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ يَغْفِرُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: تَثْرِيبَ is in the derivative form: تَثْرِيبٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ث/ر/ب   th–r–b thin layer of fat over the stomach; fingers; to point out faults, to blame, to abuse, to reproach, to upbraid. Of this root, تَثْرِيبٌ tathrıb occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
تَثْرِيبٌ tathrıb [v. n.] blame, reproof, reproach

(12:92) قَالَ لاَ تَثْرِيبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَوْمَ [but] he said, ‘You will hear no reproaches today.’
